name: Personal Library Manager
overview: Beta 8: version-aware personal lists and Watch Later, recoverable unavailable selections and native command fixes. Linux x64 only.
description: Create private personal collections from your Jellyfin catalog. Integrates native favorites, Watch Later, private list thumbnails, search, genres, pagination and recoverable deletion without deleting original media. Beta: tested on Jellyfin 12.4.0 and Linux x64 only; other hosts and architectures are not validated. The web interface requires Plugin Pages 3.0.3.0 and File Transformation 3.0.3.0, Release-12.4.0 builds. Back up your configuration and PLM data before installing. Interface translations are partial outside English/Portuguese, with English fallback. Optional native playlist mirrors remain experimental. From beta 5, remembers per-user identity and favorite intent before catalog loss; unique visible provider matches can reconnect lists and native favorites after scans. Unidentified, conflicting or duplicate matches remain pending. Explicit unlikes/deletions and current playback state are preserved. Initial baseline and backups are required; this does not recover previously unknown orphaned items or playback history. Beta 8 adds opt-in version-group presentation and transactional group removal/restoration while retaining original selections. List membership does not change native favorites or playback progress. Legacy LocalAlternateVersions groups are not repaired by this release; native split can return success while those local relations remain.

versions.changelog: Prevent native favorite actions from stalling behind catalog-resilience work and keep a concurrent unlike from being overwritten by a stale replay.

Support explicit Jellyfin version groups in personal lists and Watch Later, preserving original selections while displaying one card per group. Add transactional group removal/restoration, group-aware memberships, idempotent additions and pagination after grouping. Also include the beta 7 fixes for unavailable-item removal, native refresh controls and unrelated requests blocked by the mirror mutation gate.

Fix HTTP 500 when another plugin passes an empty GUID to clear a selection, and allow independent native user-data updates to proceed concurrently. Mirror reads remain owner-scoped, and native playlist mutations retain their protection and creation/recovery barrier.

Preserve personal-list membership and native favorite intent across catalog disappearance and item-ID changes. Reconcile unique, visible provider matches after scans settle, retain explicit unlikes and deletion markers, preserve list order/dates and current playback state, and keep unidentified or ambiguous matches pending.

Restrict full-width responsive layout to the Favorites library. Personal settings keep their original centered width, and host pages are unaffected. Retains beta 3's localized Favorites settings heading, native create-list/trash controls, active navigation and browser-title fixes.

Clarify personal collection management with a localized Favorites settings heading and remove the redundant Personal preferences eyebrow. Keep Favorites navigation selected on PLM routes and synchronize the browser tab title with the active page and interface language.

Fix saved-heart presentation: native likes and personal lists are independent. Hearts also reflect Watch Later, with private batched lookups. Includes theme and cached-page navigation fixes. Previous beta 1 archives remain immutable.

First public beta. Private lists, native favorites, Watch Later, private thumbnails, recoverable deletion, filters, pagination, theme-aware controls and interface-language preferences. Linux x64; tested on Jellyfin 12.4.0. Requires Plugin Pages and File Transformation 3.0.3.0 Release-12.4.0. Partial translations outside English/Portuguese; English fallback. Back up before installing.

name: What U Need?
overview: Beta 4: improved request navigation, read/unread notifications and decision controls. Linux x64 only.
description: Search the installed TMDb provider, request catalog content and support existing requests. Personal user queues, a general administrator queue, covers, participant context and separate unread/read notifications. Search stays open after requesting; state-aware administrator actions and refresh preserve queue filters. Native configuration and metrics, availability reconciliation, confirmed reopening and optional expiration/retention. All deletion and expiration policies default to disabled. Acquisition is manual. Upgrade migrates the WUN database to schema 3: back up binaries, plugin configuration and WUN data; restore matching binaries and database together to revert. Tested on Jellyfin 12.4.0 / Linux x64 only. User-facing page requires Plugin Pages and File Transformation 3.0.3.0 Release-12.4.0. Portuguese/English with English fallback.

versions.changelog: Reconcile requests automatically when catalog items arrive, when a library scan completes and after administrator decisions. Group episode requests by series and season, show availability clearly and open the requested episode directly.

Reduce repeated work in request queues, notifications, searches and title details. Cache public provider data with bounded retention and shared in-flight loads; keep workflow decisions, supports and read state live. Preserve list controls and cards while refreshing.

Improve request navigation and administrator workflow: correct page titles, separate unread/read notifications, full-row media-type selection, keep search after requesting, default the administrator queue to pending approval, reflect saved decisions in available actions and refresh without losing filters.

Personal queues and unique supports, enriched notifications and administrator decisions, native configuration/metrics, automatic availability reconciliation and optional retention. Tested on Jellyfin 12.4.0 / Linux x64. All deletion and expiration policies are disabled by default.

Align the Requests header tooltip with the Jellyfin Search/Profile tooltips. Uses host palette variables, matching typography and spacing, delayed hover and immediate keyboard focus. Preserves accessible labels, supports Escape and removes the browser-native title popup. Handles recreated header buttons and language changes.

First public beta: catalog search, user requests, administrator decisions, private notes, followers and notifications. Movie/series details, season covers, episode stills, availability and provider release dates. Acquisition is manual; automated monitoring workers are not included.
